title: release-cindy-plugin

goal.text: Release the composed Cindy plugin artifact while keeping source owned by main claw-kit.

requirements.summary: Verify reviewed main-repository Cindy source and publish only its complete isolated artifact to the existing independent marketplace repository.
acceptanceCriteria: Both Cindy manifests use the resolved CLI three-segment base plus a newly incremented fourth segment; the independent repository does not own a separate three-segment version line.
The claw-kit-cindy marketplace entry points at plugin.
The tagged adapter-repository ghost manifest is valid and matches vcindy-<version>.
No .cindy archive, GitHub Release, or npm package is published.

tasks.title: Inspect and classify the Cindy release baseline
tasks.detail: Select the authorized tested frozen candidate and verify its artifact family, sourceRevision and trial; absent a candidate, use candidate preparation and stop before publication. Read packages/cindy-adapter/RELEASING.md in main claw-kit. Resolve authorized CLI candidate or published @veewo/claw base, inspect both source manifests and intended changes. Separately identify authorized artifact-repository checkout; do not treat source as a submodule or publish raw plugin directory.

tasks.title: Confirm the frozen candidate version and source
tasks.detail: Read the selected candidate and its source manifest mirrors, exact dependency pins and sourceRevision. Verify the allocated family-specific version; do not bump, regenerate or synchronize workspace content during promotion. Any mismatch requires a new candidate/version, not an in-place repair.

tasks.title: Pass the exact-source release gate
tasks.detail: Require the selected frozen candidate inventory/hash, exact clean source revision, retained test evidence and seven-day trial. Read-only checks may verify template driver compatibility, but never build, export, bump or repair source during promotion. A changed input requires a new candidate.

tasks.title: Publish the Cindy marketplace source
tasks.detail: With explicit publication authority, require clean source main at the tested candidate revision and no divergence, complete the authorized source main push and verify main equality. Deliver the exact frozen Cindy tree to the existing authorized artifact repository main, review additions/removals, commit and push there, and create immutable vcindy-<candidate-version>. Verify the catalog and compare the public tree hash against the candidate. Preserve source and artifact commit identities separately; never reassemble/export from workspace, upload .cindy or create a GitHub Release. Verify both repositories’ delivery state rather than confusing the artifact push with source delivery.

tasks.title: Verify the Cindy release and optional install
tasks.detail: Verify source revision, artifact commit/tag, payload hash, manifest and repository cleanliness separately. Only when separately requested refresh/install; restart needs authorization and enabled/running validation is separate.

references.why: Owns manifest, marketplace, tag, publication, migration, and installation rules.

rules: Formal promotion requires the explicitly selected tested frozen candidate. Preserve its version and hashes; never bump, build, pack or export again. If no tested candidate exists, prepare a new version through beta:prepare and stop before publication.
Never publish npm packages or modify another adapter.
Never build or upload a .cindy archive for a marketplace release.
Never publish changed Cindy plugin bytes without increasing the manifest version.
Stop at the first failed release boundary.
